overall: The AG resolved a complaint that the school committee withheld 2016 executive session minutes after their purposes ceased, because the committee voted to release them and sent copies, so it ordered no further action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to release 2016 executive session minutes after their purposes ceased, contrary to G.L. c. 30A, § 22(f).
allegations.key_passage: In response to the complaint, the Committee voted on November 12, 2020, to release the executive session minutes and thereafter sent Mr. Mackin a copy of those minutes.
